props.name: title
props.description: Headline. Rendered as an accessibility header (text/mobile/title-sm).

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting copy. Rendered in color/text/danger per the design decision.

props.name: illustration
props.description: Visual above the text (slot). undefined → built-in themed danger badge; null → hidden; otherwise the caller's node.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: Filled primary button (e.g. Try Again). Supports a loading spinner.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Outline secondary button (e.g. Go Back). Rendered ABOVE the primary action to mirror the Figma.

states.transitions: primaryAction.loading / secondaryAction.loading toggle the per-button spinner. Caller-driven; the component holds no internal async state.

loading.placement: on the primary/secondary action button (Button loading state)
loading.error: Caller toggles action.loading during the retry; ErrorState runs no async.

edgeCases.nullData: description, illustration and both actions are optional; omitted parts are not rendered (illustration undefined→default, null→hidden).

a11y.element: View group; title is accessibilityRole=header; actions are role=button via the Button primitive
keyboard: Touch only; VoiceOver/TalkBack read the header then the buttons in order
a11y.focusManagement: none — the host BottomSheet owns modal focus (accessibilityViewIsModal)
a11y.srAnnouncements: Container is a polite live region, so the error is announced when it appears.

tests: primary does not fire while loading

ops.security: title/description are app-supplied strings rendered via <Text> (RN escapes content; no markup injection).
